implementation.state_machine: Eight durable states use transactional compare-and-set transitions and a checksummed transition journal.
implementation.handoff: Canonical schema 1.0 handoffs are checksummed, semantically validated, list-bounded, and limited to 131072 encoded bytes.
implementation.recovery: The handoff is durable before checkpointPreparing; every recorded intent is replayed after restart through idempotent host reconciliation.
implementation.acknowledgement: The project, operation, handoff, successor, and adapter are validated before state changes; repeated exact acknowledgments are idempotent.
implementation.budget: Provider-exact, serialized-size estimate, and provider-overflow inputs map to normal, checkpoint, rollover, and emergency actions.
implementation.mcp: Seven additive continuity tools expose memory-only fallback, pending handoff retrieval, external acknowledgment, resume, and status without claiming unsupported host creation.
